description: Review related source files as an application. Builds a JS/TS import graph, checks Next.js server/client and runtime boundaries, maps routes and mutations, and returns evidence-backed findings plus questions covering data, auth, reliability, tests, deployment and product fit. Pass answers in context on subsequent calls. No repository fetch or execution; the connected assistant reasons about system-level tradeoffs using the returned evidence.

accessControl.description: Identity, roles, tenant boundaries, and where authorization is enforced

constraints.description: Team, budget, delivery constraints, and alternatives being considered

criticalFlows.description: Important user journeys and business invariants

data.description: Database ownership, sensitive data, and consistency requirements

deployment.description: Hosting, runtimes, regions, and external services

purpose.description: Who uses the application and what it must do

reliability.description: Availability and recovery goals, failure handling, and monitoring

rendering.description: SEO, interactivity, freshness, and caching requirements

testing.description: Critical-flow tests and the latest build/test results

files.description: Related source/config/test files with repository-relative paths; include package.json and tsconfig.json. At most 500,000 combined content characters

target.description: Repository label for the next comparison. Send paths on each file.

name: review_application_architecture
title: Review whole-application architecture
